brief: A diagram editor for people writing LaTeX: students, lecturers and researchers who come from a .tex file and go back to one. It should feel exact and crafted, modern and a little playful, not like a SaaS dashboard.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, says 'diagram' and 'TeX' without a compass, a pencil or Overleaf green.

concepts.name: Node to Node
concepts.idea: A round node and a square node joined by a backslash, the character every TeX command starts with.
rationale: Two node shapes, one edge: the smallest possible diagram
The edge is a \, so the mark is also TeX
Coral and blue are the app's red and blue pens, brightened; indigo is its ink

recommendation: Node to Node: simplest at 16 px, works in one colour, and the circle-versus-square contrast keeps the nodes apart even in greyscale.
next_steps: Optional: add the mark to the app's sidebar header
Use the reversed lockup on dark backgrounds
